home.problem.text: 💡Rwandan farmers often get generic advice that doesn't match their specific crop, its current growth stage, or today's actual weather — and when a planting window or a rain risk is real, generic isn't enough.
home.features.heading: What Ihiga does
home.features.weather.title: Season & Weather-Aware
home.features.weather.description: Advice grounded in real-time local weather and Rwanda's actual planting seasons.
home.features.stage.title: Tracks Your Crop's Stage
home.features.stage.description: Knows what week you're in, from planting to harvest.
home.features.language.title: Speaks Your Language
home.features.talk.title: Talk or Type
home.features.talk.description: Voice input for hands-free questions in the field.
home.features.photo.title: Snap a Photo
home.features.photo.description: Visual guidance on what you're seeing in your crop.
home.features.alerts.title: Proactive Alerts
home.features.alerts.description: SMS notifications when your crop or the weather needs your attention.
home.howItWorks.heading: How it works
home.howItWorks.step1: Tell Ihiga your crop and planting date.
home.howItWorks.step2: Ask anything — by text, voice, or photo — in whichever language you prefer.
home.howItWorks.step3: Get grounded, honest advice — Ihiga tells you when advice is general versus locally verified, rather than guessing.
home.trust.text: Ihiga's advice is grounded in validated Rwandan crop and season guidance, not general assumptions.
